items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: By the time he got there, I was pretty well advanced, and I was helping him teach the saxophone players and the clarinet players

ctx.x: By the time he got there, I was pretty well advanced, and I was helping him teach the saxophone players and the clarinet players, getting them started in the early stages there.

I had a lot of good moments at (?) high school. From there I played in several band contests throughout the state, and I either won first or second prize on clarinet or saxophones. I ended up always going away with two trophies. That is, until they disqualified me because I was working with the bands around home. They declared me a professional, and so that was the end of my amateur career!
